coaching.headline: The duo lane won early, Khaimera took both Fangtooths and Orb Prime, and the map followed: eight structures to none, one allied death.

flags.text: Duo lane ran a damn clinic: enemy duo deaths five to none before minute ten.
Khaimera took Mini Prime, both Fangtooths, Orb Prime and two Seedlings, plus 56 enemy jungle minions.
Wraith razed the mid outer, inner and inhibitor with a game-high six kills and no deaths.
Out-warded the enemy 44 to 18 and took river camps 17 to 2.

focus.title: Cash every win, pair up at the pit
focus.action: After each won fight, hit the nearest tower or objective, as three of four won fights did, and the jungler enters the Prime pit beside a teammate whenever the enemy jungler is unseen.

14.7.call: Two separate plays, both won: Greystone killed Boris on the offlane and Lt. Belica in the enemy jungle, Kira killed Maco on the duo lane, and Kira razed the duo inner next.

18.3.call: Boris took Mini Prime and killed Khaimera at the Prime pit; Kira killed Boris there and Wraith killed Lt. Belica on the offlane: won 2-1 on bodies, but Mini Prime stayed with the enemy.

21.4.call: Wraith razed the mid inhibitor, then killed Boris and Maco in the enemy base; the duo inhibitor fell and Phase finished the Core. Textbook close: after the second inhibitor, straight to the Core.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Zero deaths, five kills and 19707 objective damage, the most of all ten. Took all five gold buffs; claim each spawn before the enemy duo can contest.
Hero damage ran 421 per minute against an own average of 1027, with farm at 10.7 CS per minute. Once Maco Strike! and Seismic Assault are spent, channel Purge.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: First blood on Revenant, zero deaths, 6420 healing and the final blow on the Core, but 38% kill participation. Once the enemy duo outer falls, join the next fight.
Eight wards against an own average of 10.8, while Wraith placed 22. Before each Fangtooth or Prime, fill Tranquility's raised ward cap around the pit.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Into a matchup Lt. Belica wins 54.3% of the time: two kills on Lt. Belica and zero deaths. When Seismic Assault is spent, take the Knock, Knock! trade.
Three rotation kills, two followed by a prize: the Aurora kill preceded Fangtooth and the offlane outer, the Lt. Belica kill the mid inner. Keep rotating once mid opens.
22 wards, a game high, but hero damage ran 585 per minute against an own average of 733. Open with Peekaboo!, then Knock, Knock! on the marked target.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: A hell of a frontline: 17599 mitigated and 11210 healing, both the most of all ten, with zero deaths. Keep diving only after Maco Strike! is spent.
Kills on Aurora, Boris and Lt. Belica, plus the offlane outer, while taking 13382 magical hero damage. Repeat Tainted Bastion whenever the enemy damage leans magical.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Ate 33701 damage, the most of all ten, and cleared 56 enemy jungle minions for one death. When the enemy jungler shows on the far side, keep invading.
Died once, to Boris at the Prime pit, right after Boris took Mini Prime. When the enemy jungler starts Mini Prime, call teammates before entering.

matchup: Revenant finished with zero kills and only Lightning Hawk completed; this carry wins 48.4% into Revenant across the field.
Revenant's Scar roots and Reckoning banishes, the duo lane's main crowd control alongside Maco's two stuns.
build: Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator is the most played core into Revenant, at 48.5%.
Tainted Rounds, the missing meta piece, cuts the target's healing on basic attacks; the enemy drafted no healer.
Imperator, finished last, makes critical strikes deal more damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below a health threshold, with a cooldown per hero.
Lotus leans first in this carry field and Weald ranks fifth; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair.
augment: Bringer Of Mercy cuts Mercy's mana cost and trims current ability cooldowns when Mercy deals damage.
Bringer Of Mercy leans ahead of Lenore in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active grants attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks for a few seconds.
Ortus leans first in this carry field; Pacifier and Eviscerator trail.
improvement: Skipping Tainted Rounds cost nothing proven, but Boris healed 10299; buy Tainted Rounds when an enemy heals that much.
Lotus over Weald is the field lean: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the low-health missiles.

matchup: Duo against Revenant and Maco; Maco died four times without a kill or assist.
Maco Strike! knocks back and stuns and Maco Sparkle! stuns, both area crowd control to wait out.
build: Prophecy and Plasma Blade replace the 55.4% Marshal, Windcaller and Galaxy Greaves core entirely.
Prophecy adds magical damage on basic attacks; Plasma Blade stacks critical chance on basic attacks against heroes.
Plasma Blade, finished last, was complete for only the final two fights.
eternal: Exarch makes healing or shielding grant the target attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage briefly.
Vesh and Exarch are a toss-up in this support field; Illumination with Fervour is the best Exarch pair.
augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst also restore the linked ally's mana over the duration.
Kindred Surge and Psychic Support are a toss-up in this support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's active heals self and nearby heroes and grants brief damage mitigation; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Silentium leans first in this support field; Tranquility ranks well behind.
improvement: Build notes list no unmet need; magical hero damage taken was 1500, so skipping magic resist cost nothing proven.
Illumination for Preservation matches the best Exarch pair: health regeneration from bonus mana regeneration instead of more healing received.

augment: Sniper's Bounty adds gold on Knock, Knock! killing blows, far more for heroes.
Sniper's Bounty is clearly the best augment in this midlane field. Keep.
crest: Ortus's active grants movement speed and physical power briefly; takedowns inside the window add permanent physical power.
Liberator leans first in this midlane field; Ortus ranks well behind.
improvement: Build notes flag magical armor, NOT built, into Lt. Belica; 3058 magical hero damage taken and zero deaths, so no loss proven.
Eviscerate for Cull the Weak matches the best Xyris pair: bonus damage on high-health targets instead of minion and monster damage.

eternal: Krix grows health by level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates without recent hero damage, Feeding Frenzy adds attack speed per nearby enemy hero.
Nihil leans first in this offlane field; Krix ranks second, and Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair.
augment: Imperial Soul makes Stone Forged Soul deal more damage in a larger radius.
Imperial Soul and Tainted Oath are a toss-up in this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle adds health and both armors; the active grows size and health briefly and deals true damage nearby.
Eviscerator and Saphir's Mantle are a toss-up in this offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Build notes flag tenacity, NOT built: the enemy brought 7 more hard-CC abilities. Salvation adds tenacity and a low-health shield.

matchup: Boris, the jungle opponent, scored one kill and died four times; that one kill was the lone allied death.
Boris's Primeval Roar fears and Ursine Burst pulls.
build: Overlord and Sky Splitter replace the 63.8% Malady, Terminus and Necrosis core entirely.

Pacifier and Gravitum lead a toss-up in this jungle field; Judgement ranks behind Eviscerator.

Tenacity is flagged NOT built against 7 more enemy hard-CC abilities; Salvation answers that.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 5/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
ourKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
ourKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
ourKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
ourKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
ourKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
ourKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Maco Fly! to slow and shield himself, Maco Sparkle! from range for a longer stun, Maco Gift! to heal allies or damage enemies, then a fully charged Maco Strike!
enemyKits.winCondition: Land long-distance Sparkle! stuns and charged Strike! pushes while healing and speeding up allies with Gift!
enemyKits.passive: Mach Speed! builds movement speed while moving and grants slow immunity at full stacks, lost when hit by heroes.
enemyKits.playWith: A roaming, pick-oriented team that can follow his stuns.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Hit him to remove Mach Speed! stacks. Maco Sparkle! is slow-moving and stuns longest at range, so sidestep it or close the distance; dodge the charged Strike! line.

enemyKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
enemyKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
enemyKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
enemyKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
enemyKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

2 divers (Greystone, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
5 of 5 deal physical damage: one armor item blunts most of it.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Phase can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 22 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Wraith mid players this patch.
Back It Up! at top rank: 95s base, about 79.2s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Alternator 10, Tainted Trident 10.
Wraith dealt 12,871 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +145 physical power from items.

Penetration: Alternator 10, Vanquisher 12, Tainted Trident 11; against Lt. Belica (level 13 estimated: about 89 physical armor, 56 after penetration) and Maco (level 13 estimated: about 81 physical armor, 48 after penetration) that is about 21% and 22% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).

Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: Lt. Belica took about 21% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 13 (estimated) their armor was about 89, about 56 after 33 flat penetration).
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Boris). We killed Wraith 0 times.
Copy it? Too few Wraith midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
